_verificationNote.VERBATIM_MANDATED: FIXED (structurally) 2026-08-15: requiredClauses[right-to-cancel-solicitation].text has been EMPTIED and marked VERBATIM_REQUIRED_NOT_TRANSCRIBED — the non-conforming paraphrase can no longer be rendered. Bus. & Com. 601.052 prescribes the cancellation statement VERBATIM in BOLDFACED TYPE OF AT LEAST 10 POINTS, positioned near the signature space or on the front of the receipt. The removed placeholder embedded the mandated sentence inside an added conditional ('If this transaction was solicited or agreed to at your residence...') and changed 'the buyer' to 'the consumer' — both alter prescribed text. STILL UNMODELLED: 601.052 also requires the merchant to deliver a receipt or contract copy showing the transaction date and the merchant's name and address.

dependsOn.homeImprovementThresholdCents: VERIFIED at 0. Prop. Code 53.254 imposes no dollar threshold and no statewide written-contract threshold was found. Encoding 0 is correct.
dependsOn.homesteadLienNotice: SUBSTANCE VERIFIED against Prop. Code 53.254(a)-(e): written contract; executed BEFORE material is furnished or labour performed; signed by BOTH SPOUSES if the owner is married; FILED WITH THE COUNTY CLERK of the county where the homestead is located. 53.254 does not prescribe this particular notice verbatim, so the clause may be drafted — but note 53.254(f) DOES prescribe verbatim text for the lien affidavit ('NOTICE: THIS IS NOT A LIEN. THIS IS ONLY AN AFFIDAVIT CLAIMING A LIEN.', at least 10-point boldface at the top of the page), and 53.254(g) prescribes a statement that must accompany the Subchapter C notice to the owner.
dependsOn.finalBillsPaidTrigger: FIXED 2026-08-15: the trigger is now 'always'. The previous 'total > $5,000' had NO statutory basis — Prop. Code 53.259(a) applies 'As a condition of final payment under a residential construction contract' with no monetary floor, so the old trigger suppressed a required clause on every contract under $5,000. STILL UNENCODED: 53.259(c) makes a false affidavit a misdemeanour (fine up to $4,000 and/or up to one year) and 53.259(d) imposes personal liability on the signer.
dependsOn.disclosureNoGeneralLicense: UNRESOLVED. requiredClauses[disclosure-no-general-license] asserts that Texas does not license general residential construction contractors statewide, cited only to 'Tex. Occ. Code (trade-specific chapters)' — not a section. Nothing fetched confirms it. Either cite a specific provision or remove the clause; an uncited negative statement about licensing law should not ship.
dependsOn.licenseDisplayRequired: false is consistent with the absence of any display requirement in Prop. Code ch. 53 or Bus. & Com. ch. 601 — but this is verification by ABSENCE, which is weaker than a positive cite. Re-confirm when the official host is reachable.

requiredClauses.title: Homestead lien disclosure
requiredClauses.text: UNVERIFIED — ATTORNEY REVIEW REQUIRED. [Template] NOTICE: This contract is subject to Chapter 53 of the Texas Property Code. If this property is your homestead, a contractor may not obtain a valid lien unless this contract is signed by both spouses (if married) before any work begins and is filed with the county clerk of the county where the homestead is located.

requiredClauses.title: Licensing disclosure
requiredClauses.text: UNVERIFIED — ATTORNEY REVIEW REQUIRED. [Template] Texas does not license general residential construction contractors statewide. Trade work included in this contract that requires a state license (plumbing, electrical, HVAC) will be performed by appropriately licensed tradespeople, whose license numbers are available on request.

requiredClauses.title: Final payment — bills-paid affidavit
requiredClauses.text: UNVERIFIED — ATTORNEY REVIEW REQUIRED. [Template] At final payment, the contractor will furnish an affidavit stating that all bills for labor and materials incorporated into the improvements have been paid or will be paid from the final payment, as provided by Texas Property Code §53.259.
